import re

def main():
    s = input().strip()
    pattern = re.compile(r'(.)\1*')
    matches = pattern.finditer(s)
    insert = 0
    for m in matches:
        if len(m.group()) % 2 == 0:
            insert += 1
    print(insert)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
